name: greeting_prefix
label: Greeting
help_text: Word before the member's first name, e.g. "Hi" → "Hi Jane,".

name: firstname_fallback
label: First Name Fallback
help_text: Shown when the contact has no first name on file.

name: intro_line
label: Intro Line
help_text: First sentence. Use {service} where the service name should appear — it is filled in automatically.
default: Thank you for your enquiry about {service}.

name: service_fallback
label: Service Name Fallback
help_text: Used in the intro line if the service can't be identified.

name: body_line
label: Confirmation Paragraph
help_text: Main confirmation message shown under the intro.
default: We have received your request, and a member of our team will review the information you provided and contact you shortly.

name: summary_heading
label: Summary Card Heading
help_text: Heading above the enquiry details card.

name: label_service
label: Row Label — Service
help_text: Left-hand label for the service name row.

name: label_submitted
label: Row Label — Submitted
help_text: Left-hand label for the submission date row.

name: label_reference
label: Row Label — Reference
help_text: Left-hand label for the reference number row.

name: label_details
label: Row Label — Details
help_text: Left-hand label for the details-provided row (only shows if the enquiry included a message).

name: continue_line
label: Continue-Exploring Paragraph
help_text: Paragraph shown below the summary card, above the button.
default: You can continue exploring your available services through the VIPSCLUB portal while your enquiry is being reviewed.

name: button_text
label: Button Text
help_text: Call-to-action button label. Leave empty to hide the button.

name: button_url
label: Button Link
help_text: Where the button sends the member — usually the services catalogue.

name: reply_line
label: Reply Note
help_text: Small note under the button about replying to the email.
default: Please reply to this email if you desire to provide additional or corrected information.

name: team_name
label: Team Name
help_text: Sender name shown under the sign-off.

name: accent_color
label: Accent Color
help_text: Brand colour for the summary heading and button. Defaults to VIPSCLUB red.
